test_commands.spec_tests: npx vitest run src/worker/workspaces src/web/pages/Workspaces.test.tsx src/web/pages/Workspace.test.tsx src/web/components/Markdown.test.tsx src/web/components/LinkCard.test.tsx src/web/pages/LinkDetail.test.tsx

dependencies.reason: builds on its authentication, error envelope, cursors, OpenAPI document, link store and routes, LinkCard, LinkDetail and the shared test helpers

tasks.title: Create, list, rename and delete workspaces
steps: Add the workspace behaviours to src/worker/workspaces/workspaces.test.ts and confirm they fail

Create migrations/0004_workspaces_and_notes.sql with the workspaces table (id, user_id, name, name_key for the case-insensitive uniqueness, description, note, created_at, unique on user_id and name_key), the workspace_links table (workspace_id, link_id, position, unique on workspace_id and link_id) and the links.note column defaulting to ''
Write the workspace store in src/worker/workspaces/store.ts, every query filtered by the authenticated user

Implement POST /api/v1/workspaces: trimmed name of 1 to 100 characters (400 invalid_name), description of at most 1,000 characters without a line break (400 invalid_description), 409 name_taken for a clash ignoring case, 409 workspace_limit at 200
Implement PATCH /api/v1/workspaces/{id} for name and description with the same validation, and DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/{id} removing the workspace and its memberships and no link
Implement GET /api/v1/workspaces ordered by name ignoring case, with link_count, paged with the shared cursor at most 100 per page
Answer another user's workspace id with 404 not_found exactly as an unknown one
Document the routes in the OpenAPI document and docs/api.md, and the new tables in docs/architecture.md

tasks.title: Add, order and remove workspace members
steps: Add the membership behaviours to src/worker/workspaces/workspaces.test.ts and confirm they fail

Implement POST /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/links: a new member goes to the bottom (201), a position from 1 places or moves the link there with past the end meaning the end (201 new, 200 moved), an existing member without a position changes nothing (200); 400 invalid_link_id or invalid_position, 404 for a link that is not the user's; positions stay 1..n in one transaction
Implement DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/links/{link_id}, closing the gap and keeping the link

Implement GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id} with the note and GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/links listing every member in position order whatever its state, in the stream's link shape plus position, cursor-paged
Extend the link deletion of DELETE /api/v1/links/{id} to remove the link from every workspace and close each gap in the same transaction
Document the routes in the OpenAPI document and docs/api.md

tasks.title: Store notes and carry them and the workspaces on links
steps: Add the note behaviours to src/worker/workspaces/notes.test.ts and src/web/components/Markdown.test.tsx and confirm they fail
Validate notes in src/worker/workspaces/notes.ts: a string of at most 20,000 Unicode code points (400 note_too_long 'note too long (20,000 characters)'), anything else 400 invalid_note
Accept note on PATCH /api/v1/workspaces/{id}, and on PATCH /api/v1/links/{id}, creating that route if it does not exist yet and extending it otherwise, changing no other field

Compute note_preview (first non-empty line, heading and list markers and raw HTML elements removed, trimmed, at most 200 characters, null when empty) and add note_preview and workspaces [{id, name}] by name to every link in the stream and in workspace lists; carry the whole note only on GET /api/v1/links/{id}

Write the Markdown component src/web/components/Markdown.tsx rendering with marked and sanitising with DOMPurify so that no raw HTML element or attribute, script, event handler or URL scheme other than http, https and mailto survives
Document the fields in the OpenAPI document and docs/api.md

tasks.title: Build the Workspaces and Workspace pages and the add-to-workspace action
steps: Add the page behaviours to src/web/pages/Workspaces.test.tsx, src/web/pages/Workspace.test.tsx and src/web/components/LinkCard.test.tsx and confirm they fail

Build the Workspaces page at /workspaces: list by name with member counts, create, rename, and delete after the confirmation 'Delete this workspace? Its links stay in your library.', showing the API's 409 messages

Build the Workspace page at /workspaces/{id}: the rendered note above the member cards, an in-place note editor that keeps the text and shows 'note too long (20,000 characters)' on that error, drag to reorder sending the new position, and Remove from workspace
Add the Add to workspace action to LinkCard: a picker of the owner's workspaces marking those already containing the link, adding at the bottom
Add Workspaces to the website's navigation and its typed client calls to src/web/api.ts

tasks.title: Show notes and workspaces on cards and the detail view
steps: Add the card and detail behaviours to src/web/components/LinkCard.test.tsx and src/web/pages/LinkDetail.test.tsx and confirm they fail
Show note_preview as the card's first line and one chip per workspace linking to /workspaces/{id}, and nothing when the link has neither

Show the link's note rendered with the Markdown component on the LinkDetail page, with an in-place editor saving through PATCH /api/v1/links/{id} and the 'note too long (20,000 characters)' message, and the link's workspace chips
